questions.question:
Rearrange the parts of the sentence in correct order.

Our study goes

P. beyond LDL cholesterol levels to get

Q. and the impact of eating walnuts daily

R. a complete picture of all of the lipoproteins

S. on their potential to improve cardiovascular risk
questions.solution:
The correct answer is **'Option 3' **i.e. **'PRQS'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The correct order for the sentence is** PRQS.** Here's why:
 
• **"Our study goes"** is the** starting clause **and should be followed by something that elaborates on what the study aims to do or achieve.
 
• **P.** "beyond LDL cholesterol levels to get" - This **segment indicates that the study is aiming **to achieve something more than just understanding LDL cholesterol levels.
 
• **R. **"a complete picture of all of the lipoproteins" - This** clause elaborates** further on what the study is trying to achieve, making it clear that it's not just about LDL cholesterol, but a complete understanding of all lipoproteins.
 
• **Q.** "and the impact of eating walnuts daily" - This **adds another dimension **to the study. After getting a complete picture of all the lipoproteins, the study is also considering the impact of a specific diet factor - eating walnuts daily.
 
• **S.** "on their potential to improve cardiovascular risk" - **Finally, this clause ties everything together **by explaining the ultimate aim of the study, which is to understand how all of these factors could potentially improve cardiovascular risk.

Therefore, the** rearranged sentence** is: *"Our study goes beyond LDL cholesterol levels to get a complete picture of all of the lipoproteins and the impact of eating walnuts daily on their potential to improve cardiovascular risk." Hence, the correct answer is** PRQS.***

questions.question:
**Given below are four sentences in jumbled order. Select the option that gives their correct order.**

A. He seemed to remain that high for nearly two years.

B. Kari, the elephant was five months old when he was given to me to take care of.

C. We grew together, that is probably why I never found out just how tall he was.

D. I was nine years old and I could reach his back if I stood on tiptoe.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is '**BDAC**'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The given question is an example of a Para Jumble.
 
• We know that the first statement of a para jumbled question is usually an independent general statement, a noun, a universal fact, starting off a story, starting of an incident or an event, or it starts with 'most' or 'once'.
 
• **Sentence B** will be the starting line because it contains the main idea of the para jumble i.e. Kari, the elephant.
 
• However, **Sentence D** states that the narrator was nine years old when the elephant was given to him to take care of. He could reach his back if he stood on tiptoe.
 
• So, **D** will follow **B**.
 
• **Sentence A **will be next because it mentions **'that high'** which corresponds to the height of the elephant mentioned in **sentence D.**
 
• So, **C** will follow **A **because it tells why the narrator never found out how tall Kari was.
 
• Thus, the correct sequence is:
 
 
• **B**: Kari, the elephant was five months old when he was given to me to take care of.
 
• **D**: I was nine years old and I could reach his back if I stood on tiptoe.
 
• **A**: He seemed to remain that high for nearly two years.
 
• **C**: We grew together, that is probably why I never found out just how tall he was.

 
 
 

**Correct Sequence:__** *Kari, the elephant was five months old when he was given to me to take care of. I was nine years old and I could reach his back if I stood on tiptoe. He seemed to remain that high for nearly two years. We grew together, that is probably why I never found out just how tall he was.*

questions.solution:

questions.question:
**Directions: Given below are four jumbled sentences. Select the option that gives their correct order. **

A. The father then wanted his son to pick him up at four in the afternoon so that they could go home together.

B. A teenager had just passed his driving test and was eager to drive his father’s car.

C. He asked his son to drop him at a place that was some 18 miles from home before he took the car for servicing.

D. His father agreed.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is "BDCA".

​

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The sentence 'B' is independent of any other sentences as it is giving general information about **"**A teenager". Hence, 'B' is the first part.
 
• The noun "father" mentioned in the sentence 'D' refers back to the 'father' mentioned in the sentence 'B'. Hence, 'D' follows 'B'.
 
• The pronoun "He" mentioned in the sentence 'C' refers back to the noun "father" in the sentence 'D'. Hence, 'C' follows 'D'.
 
• The sentence 'A' is the concluding sentence. Hence, the sentence 'A' is the last sentence.

 

After rearranging the sentences__: *A teenager had just passed his driving test and was eager to drive his father’s car. His father agreed. He asked his son to drop him at a place that was some 18 miles from home before he took the car for servicing. The father then wanted his son to pick him up at four in the afternoon so that they could go home together*.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **__Important Points__** 

__
 
• Important Rules to Solve the Para Jumbles__:

 
 
• Read the sentences attentively and try to comprehend the idea or theme of the sentence and eliminate the irrelevant options.
 
• Try to identify the opening (independent sentence) and closing sentences (concluding sentence).
 
• Try to identify the mandatory pairs. Two sentences can be connected through various connectors and other determinants.

questions.question:
Given below are four jumbled sentences. Pick the option that gives their correct order.

P. Fasting also leads to a feeling of rejuvenation and extended life expectancy.

Q. This might be due to the detoxification effect of fasting.

R. A study was performed on earthworms that showed the extension of life thanks to fasting.

S. The experiment was performed in the 1930s by isolating one worm and putting it on a cycle of fasting and feeding.

The isolated worm outlived the other worms by 19 generations, while still maintaining its freshness and youthful physiological characteristics.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is** 'Option 1'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The sentences follow a logical flow, **starting with the general concept of fasting** leading to a feeling of rejuvenation and extended life expectancy (P).
 
• Then** it introduces a possible reason for this effect, **which is the detoxification effect of fasting (Q).
 
• The sentence **then provides specific evidence of a study** performed on earthworms that showed the extension of life due to fasting (R).
 
• **Finally, it describes the experiment** performed in the 1930s, isolating one worm and observing its extended lifespan and maintained youthful characteristics (S).

The** correct arrangement** is as follows:

 
• **P. **Fasting also leads to a feeling of rejuvenation and extended life expectancy.
 
• **Q.** This might be due to the detoxification effect of fasting.
 
• **R.** A study was performed on earthworms that showed the extension of life thanks to fasting.
 
• **S.** The experiment was performed in the 1930s by isolating one worm and putting it on a cycle of fasting and feeding.
 
• The isolated worm outlived the other worms by 19 generations while still maintaining its freshness and youthful physiological characteristics.

Therefore, the** correct order **is: **'PQRS'.**

questions.question:
**Given below are four jumbled sentences. Select the option that gives their correct order.**

A. Ibn Al-Haitham wrote a book in seven volumes namely ‘Kitāb al-Manāẓir’ also known as ‘The Book of Optics.’

B. However, during the medieval period, the notable work of an Arab writer and scientist, Ibn Al-Haitham revolutionised the concept of physics.

C. During the ancient period, the development of Physics took place simultaneously with the development of astronomy.

D. In this book, Ibn Al-Haitham disproved the ancient Greek concept of vision and introduced a new theory.
questions.solution:

• While arranging the parts of the passage, we should find some grammatical or contextual connections between them:
 
 
• Sentence C introduces us to the simultaneous development of Physics and astronomy in ancient times. It is the introductory sentence and will be put in the first place.
 
• Sentence B tells us about an Arab writer and scientist 'Ibn Al-Haitham'. It will be put in second place.
 
• Sentence A tells us the book 'Kitab al- Manazir' written by the above-mentioned author. It will be put in third place.
 
• The last sentence is D as it mentions the contents (disproving of the ancient Greek concept of vision and introduction of a new theory) of the above-mentioned book.

 
 
 

Thus, the correct order is - *During the ancient period, the development of Physics took place simultaneously with the development of astronomy. However, during the medieval period, the notable work of an Arab writer and scientist, Ibn Al-Haitham revolutionised the concept of physics. Ibn Al-Haitham wrote a book in seven volumes namely ‘Kitāb al-Manāẓir’ also known as ‘The Book of Optics.’ In this book, Ibn Al-Haitham disproved the ancient Greek concept of vision and introduced a new theory. *

questions.question:
**Sentences of a paragraph are given below in jumbled order. Arrange the sentences in the right order to form a meaningful and coherent paragraph.**

A. The main activity of Palampur is farming and 80 families of the upper caste own the majority of land in Palampur.

B. Palampur village has around 450 families which belong to different castes and creeds.

C. The neighboring towns of the village are well connected and all-weather roads are also well connected.

D. There are other activities in Palampur like dairy, transport, small-scale manufacturing, etc. which also help run the economy in the village.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is '**BADC**'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• While carefully reading all the statements carefully we can conclude that **sentence B** is the **introductory statement.**
 
• **Sentence B** will come **first **because it is introducing us to the fact that Palampur village has around 450 families belonging to different castes and creeds.
 
• **Sentence A** will come **second **because it is talking about the **main activity** of the people of Palampur which is **farming**.
 
• **Sentence D **is in **continuation **with** sentence A** because the use of '**other activities**' in **sentence D** is indicating that apart from **farming (mentioned in sentence A)** they are also involved in **dairy, transport, small-scale industries, **etc.
 
• **Sentence C **will come **last **because it is talking about the **road connectivity** of the village.
 
• Therefore, the **correct order **is** 'BADC'.**
 
• Hence, **option 2** is the** correct answer**.

 

**The correct arrangement**:__* Palampur village has around 450 families which belong to different castes and creeds. The main activity of Palampur is farming and 80 families of the upper caste own the majority of land in Palampur. There are other activities in Palampur like dairy, transport, small-scale manufacturing, etc. which also help run the economy in the village. The neighboring towns of the village are well connected and all-weather roads are also well connected.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

__
 
• '**Majority**' means the greater number.

 
 
• **Example**: In the **majority **of cases all will go smoothly.
 
 
 
• '**Creed**' means faith. 
 
 
• **Example**: People of many **creeds **and cultures.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/51867102c7c2f369f6e29d2efe025e3b3367c68261ec20262828d84ca5c8f854.png] **Hinglish__**

__
 
• सभी कथनों को ध्यान से पढ़कर हम यह निष्कर्ष निकाल सकते हैं कि **वाक्य B introductory कथन** है।
 
• **वाक्य B पहले **आएगा क्योंकि यह हमें इस तथ्य से परिचित करा रहा है कि पालमपुर गाँव में विभिन्न जातियों और पंथों के लगभग 450 परिवार हैं।
 
• **वाक्य A** दूसरे स्थान पर आएगा क्योंकि यह पालमपुर के लोगों की **मुख्य गतिविधियां** के बारे में बात कर रहा है जो **खेती **है।
 
• **वाक्य D वाक्य A **के क्रम में है क्योंकि **वाक्य D **में **'other activities'** का प्रयोग यह दर्शाता है कि **खेती के अलावा (वाक्य A में उल्लिखित)** वे **डेयरी, परिवहन, लघु उद्योग** आदि में भी शामिल हैं।
 
• **वाक्य C** सबसे अंत में आएगा क्योंकि यह गांव की सड़क संपर्क के बारे में बात कर रहा है।
 
• अतः सही व्यवस्था **'BADC'** है।
 
• अतः** विकल्प 2** सही उत्तर है।
 
• '**Majority**' का अर्थ है 'बहुमत'।
 
 
• **उदाहरण**: In the **majority **of cases all will go smoothly.
 
 
 
• '**Creed**' का अर्थ है धार्मिक पंथ।
 
 
• **उदाहरण**: People of many **creeds **and cultures.
 
 

 

**सही क्रम: **__*Palampur village has around 450 families which belong to different castes and creeds. The main activity of Palampur is farming and 80 families of the upper caste own the majority of land in Palampur. There are other activities in Palampur like dairy, transport, small-scale manufacturing, etc. which also help run the economy in the village. The neighboring towns of the village are well connected and all-weather roads are also well connected.*

questions.question:
**Given below are four jumbled sentences. Pick the option that gives their correct order.**

P. Many years ago, Paul Bunyan was born in the north-eastern American state of Maine.

Q. His mother and father were shocked when they first saw the boy.

R. Paul was so large at birth that five large birds had to carry him to his parents.

S. When the boy was only a few weeks old, he weighed more than forty-five kilograms.
questions.solution:
Here the correct answer is **PQRS**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The correct order of the jumbled sentences is: **PQRS**.
 
• To understand the correct order, let's analyze the meaning and logical flow of each sentence:
 
• **P.** Many years ago, Paul Bunyan was born in the north-eastern American state of Maine.
 
 
• This sentence introduces the main subject, Paul Bunyan, and provides information about his birthplace.
 
 
 
• **Q.** His mother and father were shocked when they first saw the boy.
 
 
• Sentence Q follows sentence P logically, as it describes the reaction of Paul Bunyan's parents upon seeing him for the first time after his birth.
 
 
 
• **R. **Paul was so large at birth that five large birds had to carry him to his parents.
 
 
• Sentence R provides further details about Paul Bunyan's birth, emphasizing his large size and the need for five large birds to transport him.
 
 
 
• **S.** When the boy was only a few weeks old, he weighed more than forty-five kilograms.
 
 
• The final sentence, S, provides additional information about Paul Bunyan's growth, specifically highlighting his weight at just a few weeks old.
 
 
 
• By arranging the sentences in the order **PQRS**, we create a coherent narrative that follows a logical sequence of events. Sentence P introduces Paul Bunyan's birth, followed by the reaction of his parents in sentence Q. Sentence R provides a unique detail about his birth, and sentence S adds further information about his growth.
 
• Hence, the correct order is** 2) PQRS.**

**Directions: Given below are four jumbled sentences. Out of the given options, select the one that gives its correct order.**

A. According to sources, one of the degrees will have to be in the regular mode, and the other either in open and distance learning or online mode.

B. In a move to improve students’ career prospects, the University Grants Commission has approved the proposal to allow them to pursue two-degree programs at the same time.

C. A committee formed under the UGC vice-chairperson worked on the proposal based on feedback from the public.

D. Once the guidelines are notified, a student studying in a university will be able to pursue another degree program simultaneously.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is 'BCDA.'

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The sentence 'B' is independent of any other sentence as it is giving general information about "**allowing students to pursue two-degree programs at the same time**". Hence, 'B' is the first part.
 
• Sentence C will come after B as it is giving information about the responsible people behind the proposal of two-degree programs (A committee formed under the UGC vice-chairperson on feedback from the public).
 
• Sentence D will come after C as it is giving information about when a student **will be able to pursue another degree program simultaneously **(Once the guidelines are notified).
 
• The sentence 'A' is the concluding part as it is giving information about how the two-degree program will work (one of the degrees will have to be in the regular mode, and the other either in open and distance learning or online mode).

 

Paragraph after rearranging the sentences__: *In a move to improve students’ career prospects, the University Grants Commission has approved the proposal to allow them to pursue two-degree programs at the same time. A committee formed under the UGC vice-chairperson worked on the proposal based on feedback from the public. Once the guidelines are notified, a student studying in a university will be able to pursue another degree program simultaneously. According to sources, one of the degrees will have to be in the regular mode, and the other either in open and distance learning or online mode*.

• Important Rules to Solve the Para Jumbles__:

 __
 
• Read the sentences attentively and try to comprehend the idea or theme of the sentence and eliminate the irrelevant options.
 
• Try to identify the opening (independent sentence) and closing sentences (concluding sentence).
 
• Try to identify the mandatory pairs. Two sentences can be connected through various connectors and other determinants.

__

**Given below are four jumbled sentences. Out of the given options pick the one that gives their correct order.**

A. The driver had a cloudy look drove off without taking him.

B. He asked a taxi driver to take him to the shopping mall.

C. He told the driver that he could pay the fare by card, not in cash.

D. He arrived on the outskirts of a city.
questions.solution:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The given sentence is an example of a Sentence Jumble. 
 
• The first statement of a sentence jumbled question is usually an independent general statement, a noun, a universal fact, the starting of an incident, or it starts with 'most' or 'once'. 
 
• Here, in the given question the first sentence will be** 'Part D'.** Because** Part D **is the starting of an incident that is* 'arrival of someone at the outskirts of a city'. *
 
• **Part B** will be the next sentence because after arrival **'He'** took a **'taxi driver'**. 
 
• **Part C** will be the next sentence because **Part B** is connected with **Part C.** It tells us what that person told **'Driver'. **
 
• And lastly, **Part A **will be the last sentence because it tells how the driver reacted. 
 
• Therefore, as per the points mentioned above, we find that the correct answer is **Option 1. **

 ​

**Correct Sentence:__** *He arrived on the outskirts of a city. He asked a taxi driver to take him to the shopping mall. The driver had a cloudy look drove off without taking him. The driver had a cloudy look drove off without taking him.*

**C: **The producers are persons engaged in the manufacture, or import of carrying bags, multilayered packaging and sheets, and persons using them.

• The noun "manufacturers" mentioned in the sentence 'A' refers back to the phrase "**persons engaged in the manufacture**" in the sentence 'C'. Hence, 'A' follows 'C'.

After rearranging the sentences__: *The Municipal Corporation has introduced the extended producer's responsibility (EPR) for producers and generators of plastic waste.
